subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
topic: Dismantling and assembling procedure of typical capsule instruments
syllabus_extract: Dismantling and assembling procedure of typical capsule instruments.
specific_objectives: 15.1.4.2 Trainee will be able to explain capsule instruments.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of dismantling and reassembly of typical capsule instrument; Safety precautions include static discharge protection and torque limit adherence; Instructor supervision required for all steps.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a capsule instrument?
Name two common types of capsule instruments used in aircraft.
Why must static electricity be avoided during instrument handling?

development.content:
Introduction to capsule instrument construction
Identification of internal components
Standard dismantling sequence
Handling of sensitive sensing elements
Reassembly torque specifications

Step-by-step dismantling procedure
Inspection criteria for internal parts
Correct reassembly sequence
Verification of calibration marks
Final assembly checks

Common errors in reassembly
Troubleshooting assembly issues
Documentation of maintenance actions
Storage and handling guidelines
Quality assurance checklist

summary_questions: Explain the critical steps in the dismantling procedure of a capsule instrument.
Describe the safety precautions required during the reassembly of capsule instruments.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the methods and applications of electrical temperature indicating systems as covered in the next lesson plan.
